name: Emergency Reserves & Capital Preservation
targetAudience: Every Indian Investor (Fund covering 6 to 12 months of mandatory household expenses)
rebalancingMethod: Immediate top-up upon any withdrawal; Annual replenishment from savings

allocations.asset: Savings Account & Sweep FDs in Scheduled Bank
allocations.rationale: Instant T+0 liquidity for medical emergencies via UPI/Debit card

allocations.asset: Small Finance Bank FDs (within DICGC ₹5L limit)
allocations.rationale: High fixed yield (8.0%–8.5%) with zero credit risk under deposit insurance
Equity taxation (12.5% LTCG / 20% STCG) delivering superior post-tax yield vs bank FDs for 30% slab
Sovereign default-free short cash buffer via RBI Retail Direct

stressScenarios: Holds 100% of value during 2008 GFC or 2020 Covid crashes; Zero capital loss.
taxConsiderations: Arbitrage fund sleeve preserves post-tax returns; Bank FD interest taxed at slab rates.
limitations: Will not outpace lifestyle inflation over long horizons; strictly for liquidity.

name: Conservative Income (Retiree Capital Preservation)
targetAudience: Senior Citizens & Retirees seeking regular monthly/quarterly income with maximum capital safety
rebalancingMethod: Semi-Annual rebalancing; Surplus interest harvested for monthly expenses

allocations.rationale: Guaranteed quarterly sovereign payout (currently ~8.2%)

allocations.asset: AAA Corporate Bonds & Banking/PSU Debt Funds
allocations.rationale: Stable accrual yield with high credit quality
Inflation-hedged 6.5%–7.5% quarterly distribution yield with partial tax exemption
Modest equity kicker to prevent real purchasing power erosion over 10-year retirement
Geopolitical hedge + 2.5% annual cash coupon
Immediate cash buffer

stressScenarios: During 2020 crash, portfolio experienced transient drawdown of -4.2%, fully recovered within 4 months.
taxConsiderations: Section 80TTB provides ₹50,000 deduction on interest income for senior citizens.
limitations: Lower capital appreciation; highly sensitive to reinvestment risk when bond rates decline.

name: Classic Indian Balanced Growth (60/40 Equity-Debt)
targetAudience: Mid-career professionals seeking long-term compounding with controlled volatility
rebalancingMethod: Annual calendar rebalancing or when any asset drifts by > 5% absolute weight

allocations.rationale: Low-cost core domestic blue-chip corporate compounding
Alpha engine capturing India's domestic industrial expansion

allocations.asset: Direct US Equities / S&P 500 Index via LRS
allocations.rationale: Currency hedge (USD/INR) and global technological monopoly exposure
High-quality fixed income anchor mitigating equity volatility
Uncorrelated hedge against rupee depreciation and global crises
Dry powder for opportunistic equity rebalancing during market corrections

stressScenarios: Drawdown during March 2020 was limited to -16.5% (compared to -38% for pure Nifty 50).
taxConsiderations: Rebalancing done via fresh SIP inflows wherever possible to prevent premature capital gains tax.
limitations: Will underperform pure equity in raging multi-year bull markets.

name: Long-Term Diversified Growth (75/25 All-Weather)
targetAudience: Investors with 7+ year horizon aiming to build substantial multi-crore wealth
rebalancingMethod: Dynamic threshold rebalancing (±5% deviation band); SIP allocation tilting

allocations.rationale: Foundational broad-market domestic wealth engine
Rules-based momentum factor tilt delivering proven historical outperformance
High beta upside from emerging leaders in manufacturing and domestic demand
International tech diversification with USD appreciation tailwind
Tax-free redemption compounding + crisis buffer
Physical real estate income without land-buying hassles
Tactical liquidity

stressScenarios: 10-year rolling returns have historically been positive in 99.4% of historical Indian market periods.
taxConsiderations: LTCG tax of 12.5% applies to equities and REITs above ₹1.25L annual exemption.
limitations: Requires emotional discipline to hold through inevitable -20% cyclical drawdowns.

name: Aggressive High-Return Growth (90/10 Equity & Alternative Tilt)
targetAudience: Young investors (20s–30s) or high-earning individuals with massive risk capacity
rebalancingMethod: Annual portfolio review; New capital directed to lagging asset classes

allocations.rationale: High-octane growth engine of Indian industrialization
Factor exposure capturing persistent market trends
High-conviction bottom-up stock picking
Global innovation monopoly participation
Cashflow dividend reinvestment
Minimum crisis ballast
Dry powder for major market crashes

stressScenarios: In 2008 crash, this allocation dropped -52%; but generated a 6.2x return over the subsequent 10 years.
taxConsiderations: SIP and long holding periods optimize tax by delaying realization of gains.
limitations: Completely unsuitable for money needed within the next 5 to 7 years.

name: Inflation-Resilience & Currency Shield
targetAudience: Investors primarily concerned about high domestic inflation, currency depreciation, and fiscal deficits
rebalancingMethod: Semi-Annual rebalancing between real assets and paper instruments

allocations.rationale: Proven 5,000-year monetary hedge against currency debasement
Leases indexed to contractual annual rent escalations (4%–7% p.a.)

allocations.asset: Direct US Equities & USD Cash (via LRS)
allocations.rationale: Hard currency shield against rupee depreciation (historical 3.2% p.a.)
Toll road and power transmission cashflows linked to economic inflation
Coupons reset upwards as central bank hikes interest rates

stressScenarios: During high-inflation periods (e.g. 2021-2023), real purchasing power expanded by +4.8% annually.
taxConsiderations: SGB tax exemption at maturity provides unmatched after-tax purchasing power preservation.
limitations: Lacks the high compounding alpha of high-beta domestic mid/small-caps.

name: Retirement Accumulation (30-Year Career Compounder)
targetAudience: Salaried corporate & government employees building a multi-crore pension nest egg
rebalancingMethod: Lifecycle Auto-Choice (Equity weight gradually tapers from 75% at age 35 to 15% at age 55)

allocations.rationale: Guaranteed 8.25% sovereign-backed tax-free interest compounding

allocations.asset: National Pension System (NPS Tier I - 75% Equity)
allocations.rationale: Ultra-low cost (0.09% TER) with extra ₹50,000 deduction under 80CCD(1B)
EEE tax-free fortress wealth immune to debt attachment

allocations.asset: Direct Mutual Fund Equity SIPs (Large + Mid + Flexi)
allocations.rationale: Unencumbered wealth with full liquidity prior to age 60
Long-term crisis ballast

stressScenarios: Compounded across 25 years, a ₹50,000 monthly SIP generates over ₹9.8 Crores at 12% CAGR.
taxConsiderations: Massive upfront tax savings under 80C, 80CCD(1B), and 80CCD(2) corporate salary restructuring.
limitations: High statutory lock-in until age 58–60; Requires separate liquid corpus for pre-retirement life goals.

name: Retirement Withdrawal (3-Bucket SWP Architecture)
targetAudience: Retired investors living off their portfolio for 25 to 35 years without running out of money
rebalancingMethod: Bucket 1 replenished annually from Bucket 2; Bucket 2 replenished from Bucket 3 during bull markets

allocations.asset: Bucket 1: Cash, Sweep FDs & Arbitrage Funds (Years 1–3 Expenses)
allocations.rationale: Guaranteed immediate living expenses; never forced to sell equities in a market crash

allocations.asset: Bucket 2: SCSS, RBI Floating Rate Bonds & Short Debt (Years 4–8 Expenses)
allocations.rationale: Predictable accrual income feeding Bucket 1 as years pass

allocations.asset: Bucket 3: Nifty 50 Index & Multi-Asset Allocation Funds (Years 9+ Horizon)
allocations.rationale: Long-term growth engine beating inflation so the portfolio never gets exhausted
Tail-risk crisis hedge

stressScenarios: During a 3-year prolonged bear market, the retiree lives smoothly off Bucket 1 without selling a single equity share at depressed prices.
taxConsiderations: SWP from equity mutual funds triggers tax only on the capital gains portion of the withdrawal, resulting in far lower effective tax than bank FD interest.

name: Business Owner & Entrepreneur Counter-Weight
targetAudience: Founders, MSME Promoters, Factory Owners & Doctors whose primary income and net worth are tied to an active, illiquid enterprise
riskLevel: Moderate (Engineered to be completely non-correlated with business risk)
rebalancingMethod: Quarterly profits sweep into liquid/debt assets; Annual equity rebalancing

allocations.rationale: Fortress liquidity completely untouched by company creditors or bank loan guarantees
Geographic insulation: if the domestic Indian sector faces a regulatory storm, global wealth is safe
Ultimate emergency family reserve
Liquid real estate yield without taking on more commercial property debt

allocations.asset: Broad Nifty 50 Index (Avoiding own business sector)
allocations.rationale: Core passive domestic growth strictly excluding founder's own industry

stressScenarios: If the business experiences a 6-month working capital freeze, personal family solvency remains 100% unimpaired.
taxConsiderations: Investments held in individual / HUF name to ring-fence from corporate liabilities.
limitations: Lower return than reinvesting directly into high ROIC business, but essential for survival.

name: Near-Term Liabilities & Goal Protection
targetAudience: Investors saving for down payment on a home, child's university tuition, or wedding in 1 to 3 years
rebalancingMethod: Target maturity matching; Zero equity exposure

allocations.asset: Target Maturity Debt Funds (matching goal year)
allocations.rationale: Locks in current yield with zero duration risk if held to maturity

allocations.asset: Scheduled Bank & SFB Fixed Deposits (under ₹5L per bank)
allocations.rationale: Guaranteed rupee-for-rupee maturity matching goal date
Tax-efficient liquid parking for 30% slab investors

stressScenarios: 100% capital preservation during any market crash.
taxConsiderations: Arbitrage fund reduces capital gains tax to 12.5% / 20%.
limitations: Zero wealth expansion; strictly for goal preservation.

name: Alternative & Speculative Satellite Allocation (Max 10-15% of Net Worth)
targetAudience: Sophisticated investors with solid core portfolios allocating a satellite sleeve for asymmetric returns
expectedNominalReturn: 16.0% – 24.0% (High dispersion; potential total loss in individual bets)
rebalancingMethod: Strict position sizing: No single alternative bet may exceed 2% of total net worth; Harvest wins into core portfolio

allocations.asset: Category II / III AIFs (Private Equity & Venture Debt)
allocations.rationale: Access to unlisted pre-IPO Indian enterprise valuations
Asymmetric multi-bagger upside from corporate restructuring
High cash-flow velocity with automated daily re-deployment

allocations.asset: Small & Medium REITs (SM REITs Fractional Commercial)
allocations.rationale: High-yield commercial real estate assets under SEBI 2024 regulations
Systematic volatility selling and covered calls on blue-chip holdings

stressScenarios: Can experience severe multi-year J-curve drawdowns (-35% to -50%) before portfolio companies mature.
taxConsiderations: Complex tax reporting: AIF pass-through K-1 statements and business income reporting on derivatives.
limitations: Total capital loss is possible on high-risk bets; Must NEVER be funded with borrowed money or emergency reserves.

name: Concentrated Risk Diagnostic (Single-Stock / ESOP / Real-Estate Heavy)
targetAudience: Diagnostic benchmark for investors holding > 50% of net worth in employer ESOPs, a family business, or a single plot of land
maxDrawdown: -85% (Common in single corporate collapses: Enron, Yes Bank, DHFL, Credit Suisse)
rebalancingMethod: Immediate systematic divestment plan (selling 10–20% every quarter into balanced index funds)

allocations.asset: Employer Company Stock / Concentrated Single Equity
allocations.rationale: DANGEROUS CONCENTRATION: If the company faces industry distress, employee loses both primary salary AND investment net worth simultaneously
Zero liquidity; high maintenance and legal title risk
Insufficient liquidity buffer for crisis

stressScenarios: Single-stock blowups in India (e.g. telecom, infra, NBFC crises) have permanently erased 90%+ of investor wealth.
taxConsiderations: Staggering sale over multiple financial years to utilize multiple ₹1.25L LTCG exemptions and mitigate tax spikes.
limitations: This is an anti-pattern portfolio intended to educate investors on the mathematical necessity of diversification.
